title.en: An Act Appropriating Five Million Pesos from the General Fund as a Permanent Insurance Fund for the Philippine Deposit Insurance Corporation
title.orig: An Act Appropriating Five Million Pesos from the General Fund as a Permanent Insurance Fund for the Philippine Deposit Insurance Corporation

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_4083_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby appropriated from the General Fund the amount of five million pesos to constitute the permanent insurance fund created under the provisions of Section ten (a) of Republic Act Numbered Thirty-five hundred ninety-one, to be used by the Philippine Deposit Insurance Corporation to carry out the purposes of the aforesaid Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1964.
